format: C++ header file with AVX2 SIMD intrinsics
description: This file provides functions for packing and unpacking 16-bit IQ samples into compressed formats using AVX2 instructions, supporting 9-bit and 16-bit big-endian formats. It includes inline functions for packing, unpacking, and supporting different IQ bit widths, specifically optimized for high-performance signal processing in software radio systems.

methods.name: pack_avx2_register_9b_be
methods.description: Pack 16-bit IQ samples into 9-bit big-endian format within an AVX2 register.

methods.name: avx2_pack_prbs_9b_big_endian
methods.description: Pack two resource blocks of IQ samples into 9-bit big-endian format buffers.

methods.name: avx2_pack_prbs_16b_big_endian
methods.description: Pack two resource blocks of IQ samples into 16-bit big-endian format buffers.

methods.name: pack_prbs_big_endian
methods.description: Dispatch function to pack IQ samples into either 9-bit or 16-bit big-endian format based on iq_width.

methods.name: avx2_unpack_prb_9b_be
methods.description: Unpack 9-bit big-endian packed IQ samples into 16-bit signed integers.

methods.name: avx2_unpack_prb_16b_be
methods.description: Unpack 16-bit big-endian packed IQ samples into 16-bit signed integers.

methods.name: unpack_prb_big_endian
methods.description: Dispatch function to unpack IQ samples from either 9-bit or 16-bit big-endian format.

methods.name: iq_width_packing_supported
methods.description: Check if the specified IQ bit width (9 or 16) is supported for packing/unpacking.
